_note: Questions of a picture class (PERSON, PLACE, DOCUMENT, EVENT, SYMBOL) that still have no picture, with what was searched and why nothing was used. Written by hand; tools/images/build-images.mjs copies it into docs/image-todo.md. Searched on 2026-11-26.

misses.searched: loc.gov photos: "landing of the pilgrims" (3 items with no known restrictions on publication)
misses.why: Item 93509602, titled "Landing of the pilgrims", is a different engraving ("Massasoit and his warriors") and shows Native people, which the plan avoids. The other two were not checked by eye yet: 2009630827 and 2010646064.

misses.wanted: A map of the 13 original states
misses.searched: loc.gov maps: "thirteen colonies map"; loc.gov photos: "thirteen original states"
misses.why: Map records carry only the Geography and Map Division's general statement ("free to use and reuse unless a Rights Advisory statement is present"), not an item rights statement we accept. The photo hits were coats of arms (emblems) and a 1970s print of the Declaration.

misses.wanted: A map of the United States (rivers, oceans, borders)
misses.searched: loc.gov maps: "map of the united states 1900"; loc.gov photos: "map united states"
misses.why: Same map-rights problem. The photo hits are an 1846 map (old borders, would mislead), a 1914 outline map photographed for a child-labor report, and studio photos of people holding maps.

misses.wanted: A map of the U.S. territories
misses.searched: covered by the map searches above
misses.why: No item with an accepted rights statement.

misses.why: 520748 is Joe Rosenthal's Associated Press photo (credited outside the federal government). 195515 has only a small GIF. The loc.gov D-Day items say "publication may be restricted" or "rights status not evaluated". The Office of War Information search timed out.
